reference_boundary: Independently authored physical BigQuery SQL; not produced or bound by the agent executor. Only aggregate results; public dataset may change.

cases.question: Compare all-history Complete-item revenue and item counts by authorized product. Return exactly these table column aliases: product_id, completed_items, revenue. State limitations and action items, then save this analysis as Acceptance product-revenue.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT i.product_id,COUNT(*) AS completed_items,SUM(i.sale_price) AS revenue FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` i WHERE i.product_id IN UNNEST(@products) AND i.status='Complete' GROUP BY i.product_id

cases.question: Count all-history authorized order items by status. Return exactly these table column aliases: status, items. State limitations and action items, then save this analysis as Acceptance status-mix.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT i.status,COUNT(*) AS items FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` i WHERE i.product_id IN UNNEST(@products) GROUP BY i.status

cases.question: Show Complete-item revenue and item counts per calendar month across all available history for authorized products. Return exactly these table column aliases: month, items, revenue. State limitations and action items, then save this analysis as Acceptance monthly-revenue.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC(DATE(i.created_at),MONTH) AS month,COUNT(*) AS items,SUM(i.sale_price) AS revenue FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` i WHERE i.product_id IN UNNEST(@products) AND i.status='Complete' GROUP BY month

cases.question: Compare Complete-item revenue by product category across all available history. Return exactly these table column aliases: category, items, revenue. State limitations and action items, then save this analysis as Acceptance category-revenue.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.category,COUNT(*) AS items,SUM(i.sale_price) AS revenue FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` i JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON p.id=i.product_id WHERE i.product_id IN UNNEST(@products) AND i.status='Complete' GROUP BY p.category

cases.question: Calculate total Complete-item revenue, product-cost proxy and margin proxy, excluding other expenses, across all history. Do not call this net profit. Return exactly these table column aliases: completed_revenue, product_cost_proxy, margin_proxy. State limitations and action items, then save this analysis as Acceptance margin-proxy.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(i.sale_price) AS completed_revenue,SUM(p.cost) AS product_cost_proxy,SUM(i.sale_price-p.cost) AS margin_proxy FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` i JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON p.id=i.product_id WHERE i.product_id IN UNNEST(@products) AND i.status='Complete'

cases.question: For authorized Complete purchases across all history, show revenue and distinct purchasing customers by state. Return exactly these table column aliases: state, customers, revenue. State limitations and action items, then save this analysis as Acceptance state-customers.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT u.state,COUNT(DISTINCT i.user_id) AS customers,SUM(i.sale_price) AS revenue FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` i JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` u ON u.id=i.user_id WHERE i.product_id IN UNNEST(@products) AND i.status='Complete' GROUP BY u.state

cases.question: For authorized Complete purchases across all history, show revenue and distinct purchasing customers by country. Return exactly these table column aliases: country, customers, revenue. State limitations and action items, then save this analysis as Acceptance country-customers.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT u.country,COUNT(DISTINCT i.user_id) AS customers,SUM(i.sale_price) AS revenue FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` i JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` u ON u.id=i.user_id WHERE i.product_id IN UNNEST(@products) AND i.status='Complete' GROUP BY u.country

cases.question: Show authorized Complete-item revenue by customer age decade across all history; use age_band labels like 30s. Return exactly these table column aliases: age_band, items, revenue. State limitations and action items, then save this analysis as Acceptance age-band.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT CONCAT(CAST(DIV(u.age,10)*10 AS STRING),'s') AS age_band,COUNT(*) AS items,SUM(i.sale_price) AS revenue FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` i JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` u ON u.id=i.user_id WHERE i.product_id IN UNNEST(@products) AND i.status='Complete' GROUP BY age_band

cases.question: Count distinct orders containing at least one authorized product, grouped by the order status across all history. Do not count items as orders. Return exactly these table column aliases: status, orders. State limitations and action items, then save this analysis as Acceptance scoped-orders.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.status,COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders` o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` i WHERE i.order_id=o.order_id AND i.product_id IN UNNEST(@products)) GROUP BY o.status

cases.question: Compare Complete-item average, minimum and maximum realized sale price per authorized product across all history. Return exactly these table column aliases: product_id, avg_price, min_price, max_price. State limitations and action items, then save this analysis as Acceptance realized-price.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT i.product_id,AVG(i.sale_price) AS avg_price,MIN(i.sale_price) AS min_price,MAX(i.sale_price) AS max_price FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` i WHERE i.product_id IN UNNEST(@products) AND i.status='Complete' GROUP BY i.product_id

cases.question: For each authorized product across all history calculate finalized_items, returned_items and return_rate, defined as Returned/(Complete+Returned). Exclude other statuses from the denominator. Return exactly these table column aliases: product_id, finalized_items, returned_items, return_rate. State limitations and action items, then save this analysis as Acceptance return-rate.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT i.product_id,COUNT(*) AS finalized_items,SUM(CASE WHEN i.status='Returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returned_items,SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status='Returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),COUNT(*)) AS return_rate FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` i WHERE i.product_id IN UNNEST(@products) AND i.status IN ('Complete','Returned') GROUP BY i.product_id

cases.question: Compare Complete-item revenue and counts by calendar year across all available history for authorized products; flag partial years rather than assuming equal periods. Return exactly these table column aliases: year, items, revenue. State limitations and action items, then save this analysis as Acceptance yearly-comparison.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.created_at) AS year,COUNT(*) AS items,SUM(i.sale_price) AS revenue FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` i WHERE i.product_id IN UNNEST(@products) AND i.status='Complete' GROUP BY year
